caption: Right after install the app opens on a three step Setup Guide; nothing is live until the app embed is activated in the theme; the store name is hidden.

Our test order triggered the post-purchase offer: the Compare at Price Snowboard at $785.95 instead of $885.95, with a 15 minute countdown and a one-click Pay Now; the store name and order number are hidden.

Pricing follows the revenue the app adds: Free up to $100, then $9.99 to $149.99 a month, Enterprise on request. On a development store every Select plan button is greyed out; the store name is hidden.
Shopify's uninstall dialog warns that discounts the app created are deleted on removal; we cancelled it.
After one declined offer the dashboard counted 1 impression, 0 conversions and $0.00 added revenue, so the tracking picked up our test; the store name is hidden.
